scripts.build: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @larness/server build && pnpm --filter @larness/web build
scripts.check: biome ci . && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.test:poc:m3: LARNESS_POC_BROWSER=1 pnpm --filter @larness/server exec vitest run test/resources/m3-poc.test.ts test/resources/m3-preview-poc.test.ts test/resources/m3-vite-poc.test.ts test/resources/m3-failure-poc.test.ts test/resources/m3-policy-poc.test.ts
scripts.test:poc:m4: LARNESS_POC_PM2=1 pnpm --filter @larness/server exec vitest run test/resources/m4-poc.test.ts
scripts.test:pm2:m4: LARNESS_POC_PM2=1 pnpm --filter @larness/server exec vitest run test/resources/service-ops-pm2.test.ts
